import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1_000_000_000;
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXT = 65;

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] node_id = new int[MAXT][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int id_counter = 1;
    static int[][] dir = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};

    static class Pair {
        int y, x;
        Pair(int y, int x) { this.y = y; this.x = x; }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        Edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int N;
        ArrayList<Edge> E;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> g;
        int[] d, pt;

        Dinic(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            E = new ArrayList<>();
            g = new ArrayList<>(N);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            d = new int[N];
            pt = new int[N];
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            if (u == v) return;
            E.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
            g.get(u).add(E.size() - 1);
            E.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            g.get(v).add(E.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs(int S, int T) {
            Arrays.fill(d, N + 1);
            d[S] = 0;
            LinkedList<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == T) break;
                for (int idx : g.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = E.get(idx);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && d[e.v] > d[e.u] + 1) {
                        d[e.v] = d[e.u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[T] != N + 1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, int T, long flow) {
            if (u == T || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (int i = pt[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = E.get(g.get(u).get(i));
                Edge oe = E.get(g.get(u).get(i) ^ 1);
                if (d[e.v] == d[e.u] + 1) {
                    long amt = e.cap - e.flow;
                    if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
                    long pushed = dfs(e.v, T, amt);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        oe.flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
                pt[u] = i + 1; // update pointer
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long max_flow(int S, int T) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(S, T)) {
                Arrays.fill(pt, 0);
                long flow;
                while ((flow = dfs(S, T, -1)) > 0) {
                    total += flow;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        // Initialize dist
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        // assign node ids
        for (int time = 0; time <= t + 1; time++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    node_id[time][i][j] = id_counter++;
                }
            }
        }
        int source = 0;
        int sink = id_counter;
        id_counter++;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        // BFS from all 'Z' cells
        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new Pair(i, j));
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = q.poll();
            int uy = p.y, ux = p.x;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int vy = uy + dir[d][0];
                int vx = ux + dir[d][1];
                if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && grid1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && dist[vy][vx] == -1) {
                    dist[vy][vx] = dist[uy][ux] + 1;
                    q.add(new Pair(vy, vx));
                }
            }
        }

        // cap distances
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (dist[i][j] == -1 || dist[i][j] > t) dist[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(id_counter);

        // source edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] >= '1' && grid1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dinic.add_edge(source, node_id[0][i][j], grid1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // time edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y' || grid1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int vy = i + dir[d][0];
                    int vx = j + dir[d][1];
                    if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && grid1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && grid1[vy][vx] != 'Z') {
                        for (int x = 0; x < t; x++) {
                            if (dist[vy][vx] >= x + 1 && dist[i][j] > x) {
                                dinic.add_edge(node_id[x][i][j], node_id[x + 1][vy][vx], 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // sink edges (two steps combined)
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y' || grid1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (grid2[i][j] >= '1' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int cap = grid2[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int x = 0; x <= t; x++) {
                        dinic.add_edge(node_id[x][i][j], node_id[t + 1][i][j], cap);
                    }
                    dinic.add_edge(node_id[t + 1][i][j], sink, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.max_flow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
